title: PFM Settings
description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) settings: one row per setting the app and flows read (wing name for the subtitle, PFM mailbox, defaults). Values are entered on the government computer, never in the code repository.
ref: PFM 2026-11-11 (naming doc: PFM Settings). Members read only; only the PFM office edits (PFM 2026-11-12, P2A).

fields.ref: What the setting does and who reads it

seed.Title: CoordinationSuspenseBusinessDays
seed.SettingNotes: Business days a coordinator gets to respond (DAFMAN 90-161 5.2). Flows count weekdays only; holidays not excluded.

seed.Title: GuardReserveApplicabilityCalendarDays
seed.SettingNotes: Calendar days for Guard Applicability and Reserve Applicability coordinators below major command (MAJCOM) level (DAFMAN 90-161 5.2.2).

seed.Title: PublicationsSiteName
seed.SettingNotes: The wing site name in the ACCESSIBILITY statement ("This publication is available for download on the XXX-XXX SharePoint."). Set once at install (PFM 2026-11-13).

seed.Title: PublicationsListUrl
seed.SettingNotes: Address of the master publications list; the hyperlink behind the site name in the ACCESSIBILITY statement. Set once at install (PFM 2026-11-13).

seed.Title: PFMOfficeMailbox
seed.SettingNotes: PFM office mailbox that sends the AO-appointment and org-box e-mails (List design 2026-11-12 s6). Value entered by the PFM.

seed.Title: EscalationWeekdays
seed.SettingNotes: Weekdays before the org-box notice escalates (PFM 2.5B; List design 2026-11-12 s6). Value entered by the PFM.

seed.Title: RecordsFreeze
seed.SettingNotes: Yes or No. While set, stops every closeout deletion of Working Files (PFM 4.6A; AFI 33-322 6.1.1.4.3; List design 2026-11-12 s7). Value entered by the PFM.
